messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 15):
"""
Where Insurers wish to withdraw any product(s), add-on(s), rider(s), the same shall be informed vide Form IRDAI-HPW (Annexure – 5) within 30 (thirty) days from the date of withdrawal. 2. The decision to withdraw any Health Insurance product /add-on/rider shall be taken by the PMC. The reason for withdrawal of the product shall be clearly documented and filed with the PMC. 3. The Policy document shall clearly indicate the possibility of withdrawal of the product/add-on/rider in future and suitable options that would be made available to the policyholder on withdrawal of the products. 4. A withdrawn Individual Health Insurance product/add-on/rider shall not be offered to new customers after the date of the withdrawal. 5. The existing customers of a withdrawn product shall be provided the following options: a.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"How many days does an insurer have to inform the PMC after deciding to withdraw a health insurance product, add-on, or rider?","answer":"An insurer must inform the PMC within 30 days from the date of withdrawal.","facts":["within 30 (thirty) days from the date of withdrawal","The decision to withdraw any Health Insurance product /add-on/rider shall be taken by the PMC"]},{"question":"What must insurers do with a withdrawn individual health insurance product or add-on for existing customers?","answer":"They must provide the existing customers with the options listed in the policy document for withdrawal of the product/add-on/rider.","facts":["The Policy document shall clearly indicate the possibility of withdrawal of the product/add-on/rider in future and suitable options that would be made available to the policyholder on withdrawal of the products","A withdrawn Individual Health Insurance product/add-on/rider shall not be offered to new customers after the date of the withdrawal"]}]}
